parts.zh: W: 石黑先生，您有没有在二手书店里发现过自己写的书？
M: 有。这种事挺让人难受的
W: 当作家需要脸皮厚一点吗？
M: 是的。比如说，我妻子可能会非常严厉
W: 即使是在您获得布克奖之后？
M: 她完全不会感到畏惧
W: 但您绝不会在自己的创作理念上妥协
M: 不会，我绝不会在根本性的东西
W: 那您为什么把《被掩埋的巨人》搁置了这么久？显然
M: 我经常会停下正在写的书
W: 最终写完一本书是什么感觉？

items.stem: How would the man feel if he found his book in a second-hand bookstore?
What does the man's wife think of his books?

choices.text: They are worthy of a prize.

items.stem: What does the man do when he engages in writing?

choices.text: He seldom writes a book straight through.
choices.zh: 他很少从头到尾一气呵成地写完一本书。

choices.text: He draws on his real-life experiences.
choices.zh: 他借鉴自己的真实生活经历。

choices.text: He often turns to his wife for help.
choices.zh: 他经常向妻子寻求帮助。

items.stem: What does the man want to say by mentioning the football match?

choices.text: Writing a book is just like watching a football match.
Writers actually work every bit as hard as footballers.
choices.zh: 作家实际上和足球运动员一样努力工作。

choices.text: He likes watching a football match after finishing a book.
choices.zh: 他喜欢在完成一本书后看足球比赛。

choices.text: Unlike a football match, there is no end to writing a book.
choices.zh: 与足球比赛不同,写书没有尽头。

items.stem: What are the speakers talking about?

choices.text: Achievements of black male athletes in college.
choices.zh: 黑人男性运动员在大学中取得的成就。

choices.text: Financial assistance to black athletes in college.
choices.zh: 大学中对黑人运动员的经济资助。

choices.text: High college dropout rates among black athletes.
choices.zh: 黑人运动员在大学中的高辍学率。
黑人运动员的本科入学情况。

items.stem: What is the new finding about black male athletes in this study?

choices.text: They display great talent in every kind of game.
choices.zh: 他们在各种比赛中都展现出极大的天赋。

choices.text: They are better at sports than at academic work.
choices.zh: 他们更擅长体育运动而非学业。

choices.text: They have difficulty finding money to complete their studies.
choices.zh: 他们难以找到完成学业的资金。

choices.text: They make money for the college but often fail to earn a degree.
choices.zh: 他们为大学赚钱,但往往无法获得学位。

items.stem: What is the graduation rate of black male athletes?
What accounts for black athletes' failure to obtain a college degree according to the man?

choices.text: Coaches lack the incentive to graduate them.
choices.zh: 教练缺乏让他们毕业的动力。

choices.text: College degrees do not count much to them.
choices.zh: 大学学位对他们来说不太重要。

choices.text: They have little interest in academic work.
choices.zh: 他们对学业没有什么兴趣。

choices.text: Schools do not deem it a serious problem.
choices.zh: 学校不认为这是一个严重的问题。

items.stem: What is the speaker mainly talking about?
How many people will shop on Cyber Monday?
What does Fortune say about traditional shopping malls?

choices.text: They find it hard to survive.

items.stem: What is said to account for the increased number of shoppers?
What do we learn about the "superbugs"?

choices.text: They are new species of big insects.
choices.zh: 它们是大型昆虫的新物种。
它们是过度开处方的抗生素。
它们是危及生命的疾病。
它们是具有抗生素耐药性的细菌。

items.stem: What is the result of the overuse of antibiotics?

choices.text: Antibiotics are now in short supply.
Many infections are no longer curable.
choices.zh: 许多感染不再能够治愈。

choices.text: Large amounts of tax money are wasted.

items.stem: What is most urgently needed for tackling the large life-threatening epidemic, according to the speaker?
What does the speaker say about a university?

choices.text: It is accessible only to the talented.
choices.zh: 它只向有才能的人开放。

choices.text: It improves students' ability to think.
choices.zh: 它提高学生的思考能力。

choices.text: It starts a lifelong learning process.
choices.zh: 它开启了一个终身学习的过程。

choices.text: It gives birth to many eminent scholars.
choices.zh: 它孕育了许多杰出学者。

items.stem: What do we learn from the speaker's stories about universities?
What does the speaker see in the young man who challenged his paper?

choices.text: His eagerness to find a job.

items.stem: What does the simple test suggest?

choices.text: Few people know how to retrieve information properly.
choices.zh: 很少有人知道如何正确检索信息。

choices.text: People can enhance their memory with a few tricks.
choices.zh: 人们可以通过一些技巧增强记忆力。

choices.text: Most people have a rather poor long-term memory.
choices.zh: 大多数人的长期记忆相当差。

choices.text: People tend to underestimate their mental powers.
choices.zh: 人们往往低估自己的心智能力。

items.stem: What do we learn about the two lists in the test?

choices.text: They present the states in a surprisingly different order.
choices.zh: 它们以令人惊讶的不同顺序呈现各州。

choices.text: They include more or less the same number of states.
choices.zh: 它们包含的州数量大致相同。

choices.text: They are exactly the same as is shown in the atlas.
choices.zh: 它们与地图册中显示的完全相同。

choices.text: They contain names of the most familiar states.
choices.zh: 它们包含最为人熟知的州的名称。

items.stem: What does the speaker suggest about preparing for and taking an exam?

choices.text: Focusing on what is likely to be tested.
choices.zh: 关注可能被测试的内容。

choices.text: Having a good sleep the night before.
Reviewing your lessons where the exam is to take place.
choices.zh: 在考试举行地点复习功课。

choices.text: Making sensible decisions while choosing your answers.
choices.zh: 在选择答案时做出明智的决定。

items.stem: What tip does the speaker give on learning?

choices.text: Discover when you can learn best.
choices.zh: 发现你什么时候学习效果最好。

choices.text: Change your time of study daily.
Give yourself a double bonus afterwards.
Follow the example of a marathon runner.
choices.zh: 效仿马拉松运动员的榜样。

items.stem: What does the speaker do?
Where does the speaker say we can find extreme poverty?
What do we learn about American people living in relative poverty?

choices.text: They have no access to health care, let alone entertainment or recreation.
choices.zh: 他们无法获得医疗保健,更不用说娱乐或休闲了。

choices.text: Their income is less than 50% of the national average family income.
choices.zh: 他们的收入低于全国平均家庭收入的50%。

choices.text: They work extra hours to have their basic needs met.
choices.zh: 他们需要加班工作来满足基本需求。

choices.text: Their children cannot afford to go to private schools.
choices.zh: 他们的孩子上不起私立学校。
